description: Erection of a detached outbuilding / play room in rear garden
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (SI / 2019018 / 000; SI / 2019018 / 01; SI / 2019018 / 02; SI / 2019018 / 03  Received:  22 July 2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No additional doors, windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for the purposes shown in the approved drawings or for other purposes incidental to the enjoyment of 19 Downs View, TW7 5HF as a single family house, and not as a self-contained dwelling unit nor for business purposes, nor shall any kitchen, bathroom or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
Condition : 5 - The materials used in the development hereby approved shall be painted render, white UPVC double glazed doors/ windows and red concrete or clay roof tiles.
